problem_text:
A logistics firm must dispatch a specialized technician to perform maintenance on ten critical server facilities distributed across a metropolitan area.

The travel durations between facilities are recorded in minutes:
* Facility Alpha to Beta: 142.7 minutes
* Alpha to Gamma: 51.7 minutes
* Alpha to Delta: 109.5 minutes
* Alpha to Epsilon: 91.4 minutes
* Alpha to Zeta: 91.3 minutes
* Alpha to Eta: 163.4 minutes
* Alpha to Theta: 37.8 minutes
* Alpha to Iota: 51.4 minutes
* Alpha to Kappa: 72.1 minutes
* Beta to Gamma: 95.9 minutes
* Beta to Delta: 101.8 minutes
* Beta to Epsilon: 135.4 minutes
* Beta to Zeta: 106.8 minutes
* Beta to Eta: 23.6 minutes
* Beta to Theta: 165.8 minutes
* Beta to Iota: 91.4 minutes
* Beta to Kappa: 83.2 minutes
* Gamma to Delta: 99.8 minutes
* Gamma to Epsilon: 102.4 minutes
* Gamma to Zeta: 51.9 minutes
* Gamma to Eta: 118.3 minutes
* Gamma to Theta: 84.7 minutes
* Gamma to Iota: 19.0 minutes
* Gamma to Kappa: 21.1 minutes
* Delta to Epsilon: 41.0 minutes
* Delta to Zeta: 147.0 minutes
* Delta to Eta: 108.2 minutes
* Delta to Theta: 107.2 minutes
* Delta to Iota: 81.0 minutes
* Delta to Kappa: 109.0 minutes
* Epsilon to Zeta: 154.0 minutes
* Epsilon to Eta: 145.5 minutes
* Epsilon to Theta: 76.5 minutes
* Epsilon to Iota: 84.2 minutes
* Epsilon to Kappa: 118.0 minutes
* Zeta to Eta: 130.1 minutes
* Zeta to Theta: 128.7 minutes
* Zeta to Iota: 69.9 minutes
* Zeta to Kappa: 38.0 minutes
* Eta to Theta: 184.0 minutes
* Eta to Iota: 112.2 minutes
* Eta to Kappa: 106.6 minutes
* Theta to Iota: 77.8 minutes
* Theta to Kappa: 105.8 minutes
* Iota to Kappa: 34.5 minutes

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient circuit that allows the technician to visit every facility precisely once, concluding the route at the initial departure point.
